title: Dose-Exposure-Response in Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: To investigate the dose-exposure-response relationship of insulin glulisine (HMR1964) after single subcutaneous injections of 0.075, 0.15 and 0.3 U/kg body weight with the euglycaemic clamp technique using the Biostator (TM).
